sections.A: Hip fracture ran ki haddi ke upar wale hisse ka fracture hai (femoral neck ke andar ya bahar). Zyada tar bari umar mein girne se hota hai aur aksar surgery hoti hai.
sections.B: Girne ke baad hip ya groin dard, wazan na utha sakna, aur taang chhoti aur bahar mudi hui.
sections.C: Surgery ke baad: kaun si surgery hui, wazan aur movement ki kya pabandi hai, aur kaise gire.
sections.D: Chart dekhein (surgery, Hb, vital signs, oxygen, yaad-dasht), aur bistar se uthane se pehle vital signs.
sections.E: Cumulated Ambulation Score aur TUG se chalne ki salahiyat aur girne ka risk napte hain.
sections.F: Surgery ke baad ke masle: pindli mein dard aur sujan (DVT), achanak saans ki takleef (PE), aur confusion (delirium).
sections.G: Achanak saans ki takleef, seene ka dard, tez dhadkan ya kam oxygen, ya BP girna aur chakkar: mobilisation rokein aur medical team ko batayein.
sections.H: Day 0 se 1: medical stability check karein, phir bistar se uthayein. Har din vital signs aur complications dekhein.
sections.I: Manual therapy tarjeeh nahi; sirf aaraam ke liye halka kaam.
sections.J: Bistar mein ankle pumps, quadriceps aur gluteal sets aur gehri saans; phir sit-to-stand, chalna aur balance.
sections.K: Sujan aur dard ke liye barf, zaroori nahi. Stockings aur khoon patla karne ki dawa medical faisla hain.
sections.L: Surgery se pehle seene ki care, Day 0-1 bistar se uthana, ward mein roz exercise, phir ghar par wapsi aur girne se bachao.
sections.M: Chalne ka faasla aur sahara, TUG, transfers, dard, girne ka darr aur pehle jaisi zindagi par wapsi.
sections.N: 82 saal ki khatoon ki kal hemiarthroplasty hui. Khud socho uthane se pehle kya check karna hai, phir jawab dekho.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
